pages.text: A flat wagon that lays track: stacks of it show along its deck.

Click it for its store (27 slots; hoppers reach it too). Load it with $(item)Train Track$() and something to fill dips: stone, cobblestone, dirt or gravel (or deepslate, andesite, tuff, sandstone, netherrack...).$(br2)Couple it at the $(l)front$() of a train, drive to the end of the line and keep going: it lays track ahead of itself, holding the train to a walk.

It carries the line straight on, diagonals too. $(l)Steer$() left or right ($(k:key.left) / $(k:key.right)) and it lays a smooth 45° bend that way, then goes straight on: one bend for each press.$(br2)The line stays $(l)level$(): it digs a cutting through hills, three wide and four high, keeping what it digs, and fills dips up to six deep under the track.
Through a hill, over a gully and round a bend.

It stops when it's out of track or fill, at water or lava, at a drop too deep to fill (bridge it by hand and carry on), and at bedrock, chests or other track right in the way. Its screen says why, and so does a message to the driver.$(br2)The switch in its screen turns it off: then it's an ordinary wagon.
Its screen: the store, the switch and what it's doing.
